title: Design System: Dash AI Open Source

display.purpose: The single hero h1 in Fredoka 700.

title.purpose: Plate names, spec-list headings, step headings in Fredoka 600-700.

label.purpose: Quoted plate labels, buttons, chips and links in Fredoka.

ai-face.purpose: The letters AI inside Fredoka headings, set in Figtree 800 because Fredoka's capital I reads as a lowercase l.

shadows.name: goods-lift
shadows.purpose: Resting depth for plates, panels and buttons (light).

shadows.name: keyline-ring
shadows.purpose: Navy ring outside the 5px keyline border on every raised object.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: Lifts, tilts, pops and wiggles on plates, buttons, chips and tabs. Disabled under reduced motion.

narrative.overview: The org is a character-goods catalog. Each project is a plate: a pastel card with a white keyline, a small mascot built only from the Dash AI slash mark, a quoted function label, a navy name pill, a birthday and one line. Navy and violet are the only saturated colors in the chrome; every plate adds one pastel and one saturated ribbon on its character's slash. Light and dark are both first-class. The shipped hero is a three-plate roster: DocMyRepos, the openspec-hud egg and the Your idea egg.
keyCharacteristics: Pastel plate per project on a lavender ground, white keyline plus navy ring around every raised object.
Characters drawn from the slab-and-slash mark only; hatched characters have eyes, unhatched ones are dashed outlines with closed lids.
Fredoka for display and labels, Figtree for reading text.
Pill is the only control shape; large soft radii on every panel.
Straight-quoted function label on every plate.

rules.name: The Two Saturated Rule
rules.body: Navy and violet are the only saturated colors in structure. Ribbon colors appear only on a character's slash.

rules.name: The Violet Ink Rule
rules.body: Violet as text always uses the text-safe value (#6320d8 light, #b79bff dark); bright violet is for fills, outlines and decoration.

rules.name: The Ink Inversion Rule
rules.body: Dark mode inverts navy fills (name pill, primary button) to Night Ink with navy text rather than keeping navy on navy.

rules.name: The Straight Quote Rule
rules.body: Function labels and the spec-list headings are wrapped in straight ASCII double quotes. Curly quotes are not used.

rules.name: The AI Face Rule
rules.body: The letters AI inside headings are set in Figtree 800, because Fredoka's capital I reads as a lowercase l.

rules.name: The Display-Is-Rounded Rule
rules.body: Headings, names and controls are Fredoka; body copy is never Fredoka.

rules.name: The Cut-Out Rule
rules.body: Raised objects always carry the keyline plus ring pair; the keyline is white in light mode and the ground color in dark mode.

dos: Do give every project its own plate: tone, ribbon, quoted function label, name pill, born line, one-line description, link.
Do draw characters only from the slab-and-slash mark; hatched ones with eyes, unhatched ones as dashed eggs.
Do keep the quote label in straight ASCII quotes and literal in meaning.
Do set "AI" in headings with the `ai` class (Figtree 800).
Do use Violet Ink for violet text on pastels and put bright violet on fills and outlines.
Do ship both themes: define every new color as a light/dark pair and mirror it in the `data-theme` and `prefers-color-scheme` blocks.
Do use the keyline plus ring pair on any raised object.
donts: Don't use curly quotes around labels.
Don't add a third saturated color to the chrome; extra hues belong on a ribbon only.
Don't use hard offset shadows; depth is the soft Goods Lift plus the ring.
Don't set body copy in Fredoka or headings in system fonts.
Don't fill an egg or give it eyes; it stays unhatched until the project ships.
Don't build the dark hero, screenshot, three-feature-cards template.
Don't show a project that is not real, or invent features, dates or stats for an unhatched plate.
